text: The Patriots are heading into Week 5 against a surprisingly hot Raiders squad quarterbacked by Kirk Cousins, who's been one of the NFL's most pleasant shocks this season—though at least the home crowd at Gillette Stadium will get to see New England's throwback uniforms while they work to build momentum as a 2-2 team facing a 3-1 opponent. On the injury front, there's mixed news to digest: Rhamondre Stevenson has returned to practice after dealing with an injury that had raised some running back questions, though Christian Gonzalez and Carlton Davis remain sidelined, and the team has made some roster moves by signing safety Mike Brown to the 53-man roster from the practice squad and linebacker Jose Ramirez to the practice squad. Between the on-field challenges and the off-field updates—including Kraft Sports + Entertainment's new JetBlue Loft at Gillette Stadium adding 15,000 square feet of premium hospitality space—the Patriots have plenty happening as they prepare for an AFC matchup that the national media seems to view favorably for New England's chances.
